[center]This mod is an alternative portrait pack for Sebastian that I made in order to be used alongside siamece's portrait overhaul mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift[/url]. The art style and the color palette of my portraits are both inspired by the Vanilla Facelift mod; however, I did draw and edit the portraits myself.

Additionally, I must mention that this mod was also made in order to be used alongside Akumea's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7733]Taller and Cuter Sebastian Sprite[/url] mod. I highly recommend this mod since it complements this portrait mod quite nicely, but it's not required.

Edit: I have made an unoffical 1.6 update to Akumea's sprite mod so now the sprites include Sebastian's winter outfit! Link is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26098]here[/url]﻿.

Anyways, on a final note, I highly recommend using the "Amity Tomato Blush" configuration of this portrait pack alongside the use of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8108]Possessive Sebastian[/url] mod. The config has that desperately flustered vibe that I think fits well with the mod.

Configs can be easily switched on or off with Generic Mod Config Menu (linked under "Required Mods").[/center]
